summary:
Purgatory Pitstop is a fully-voiced, choice-based narrative game with restaurant management elements.

You inherit the only diner on the road to the infamous afterlife gate. Customers arrive at their lowest point, and it's up to you whether to exploit their desperation for profit, try to help them find a better path, or walk an uneasy line between both to keep your struggling business afloat.

TALK TO CUSTOMERS - Raise their spirits with some friendly advice and a warm meal, or beat them while they're down and take advantage of their reliance on alcohol?

COOK COMFORT FOOD - Win over your customers by cooking them a dish that reminds them of a time, place, or person. Be careful though, physics and food are a messy combination!

UPGRADE YOUR DINER - Purchase upgrades that make cooking easier, help you change your morality score, or even assist you in generating more money!

PURGATORY PITSTOP - Shape your story through every interaction with the wonderfully weird and wackily woeful patrons of your diner, each of your choices will contribute to a unique ending, to both your story and those of individual customers.
